title: 武松打虎
narrative: 暮色渐沉，武松提着哨棒独自穿过景阳冈，酒意未散，却仍步伐沉稳。山风掠过枯枝，林间忽然传来低沉兽吼，他停步侧耳，警觉地握紧木棒。就在他抬头的一瞬，斑斓猛虎自乱石坡后猛然跃下，挟着腥风直扑面门。武松闪身避开，哨棒顺势横扫，却被虎势震得脱手飞出。失了兵器，他反而怒气陡起，翻身扑上，与猛虎在枯叶与碎石间滚作一团。虎爪连挥，獠牙逼近，他死死扼住虎颈，一拳接一拳猛击额骨。伴着野兽最后一声嘶吼，虎身终于瘫倒不动。夜风吹散尘土，武松喘息着起身，立于死虎之前，山林重新归于寂静。
style_anchor: Chinese ink action cinema style, dusk mountain forest, cold moonlit haze, swirling dust and fallen leaves, muscular hand-to-hand combat, dramatic brush-texture rocks and pines, high-contrast cinematic framing

wusong.ref_description: Wu Song, a powerful Song-dynasty martial hero, rugged face, muscular body, dark blue sleeveless vest over pale robe, carrying a wooden staff, fierce and fearless.
wusong.appearance: A rugged Song-dynasty warrior in his prime, broad-shouldered and powerfully built, sun-browned skin, stern thick brows, sharp determined eyes, short black hair tied loosely back, faint stubble on jaw, wearing a weathered off-white inner robe under a dark blue sleeveless outer vest, wide leather belt, cloth leg wraps, straw sandals, carrying a wooden staff, posture steady and explosive.

tiger.ref_description: A huge ferocious tiger with bright orange fur, black stripes, white muzzle, powerful shoulders, long fangs, and a deadly predatory stare.
tiger.appearance: A massive ferocious tiger with vivid orange fur, bold black stripes, white fur around muzzle and chest, heavy forelimbs, powerful shoulders, wide jaws showing long curved fangs, bright predatory eyes, thick tail lashing behind, body low and coiled with explosive force.
